slides.title: What are you *still carrying?*
slides.sub: A ten-minute exercise for a crowded head.

slides.title: Write it all down
slides.body: Every unfinished thing you're holding in your head. The call you owe. The decision you keep putting off. The conversation you haven't had.

slides.title: Don't sort yet
slides.body: Big or small, it all goes on the page. The point is to see how much you've been carrying, not to judge it.

slides.title: Now pick one
slides.body: Not the biggest. The one you could close this week. Write the first step next to it.

slides.title: Then notice
slides.body: How does it feel to see it on paper instead of circling in your head? That feeling is worth paying attention to.
